title: dont reject valid variants
rule: Don’t reject valid variants — accept `+` addressing in email (`naam+werk@…`); postcodes with/without space and case; trim pasted leading/trailing spaces. Normalise in software instead of erroring the person.

citation.source: NL Design System — Keur niet te snel af

pass_when: Email accepts `+` in the local-part; postcode variants with/without space and mixed case are accepted and normalised; pasted spaces are trimmed.
fail_when: `naam+werk@…` is rejected; `1234 AA` vs `1234AA` vs case/spaces is rejected instead of normalised.
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil
do_not_claim: HTML `pattern`/mask ban as this row; format-upfront copy as this row.
